purpose: Allow imported ordinary noncovering index-read producers to be copied for shared consumers when channel spilling is unavailable.
admission_contract: Only Strategy LookupRows with an empty JoinKind.
No fetched-row expression, prefix computation, SourceRead recovery expression, residual key pairs or chained lookup semantics.

CanDuplicateSubtree still recursively verifies every producer and referenced subplan; the added case does not bypass input limits, nonrepeatable settings, embedded OLAP programs or unsupported operators.
copy_contract: The copied plain lookup starts with fresh physical properties and shares only immutable table metadata.
CopyColumns allocates or validates fresh fetched-column bindings using storage names; conflicting requested labels receive a fresh compatible IU.
LookupKeys is copied in its existing physical primary-key order with unchanged storage-name values.
The existing TLogicalCopyContext second pass invokes RenameUsedIUs to replace lookup key IDs with copied producer IDs after all definitions exist.
AllowNullKeys is copied explicitly; C47 imported nullable primary keys retain lookup behavior.
The existing C47 TOpRead copy preserves ReadSettings and RangeInfo; repeatability checks still inspect their computations.
source_evidence: copy_logical_subtree.cpp: CanCopyTableLookup, IsRepeatable, TLogicalCopyContext::Run, CopyColumns, TOpTableLookup::CopyImpl
logical_renames.cpp:137 TOpTableLookup::RenameUsedIUs substitutes ordered key IDs without modifying storage names
kqp_operator.cpp:1047 plain lookup constructor initializes fresh properties; ComputeOutputIUs exposes fetched columns only
kqp_plan_conversion_utils.cpp: C47 explicit index import creates plain lookup and sets AllowNullKeys; shared import memoization introduces Replicate before optimization
rules/expand_replicate.cpp: CopyProducer maps the copied output IDs into the consumer port namespace
scope_limits: LookupJoinRows, automatic noncovering lookup nodes carrying SourceRead, prefix/chained lookup programs and nonrepeatable/limited producers remain excluded.
This is not a general materialization fallback and does not change spilling configuration.
The archived nullable/keyless residual-join identity restriction remains a distinct unverified concern.

direct_ir_adapter.required_interface: C47 ReadSettings; pre-amendment C47 or amended C47
direct_ir_adapter.scope: Copy/repeatability and IU/storage-key contracts; native query coverage is separate

integration: harness_provenance owns native registration and AST evidence enforcement; root owns serial guarded builds/native verification.
